name: Famine
value: Risk of Famine: Sudan, Somalia; none confirmed
summary: FEWS NET assesses risk of Famine in Sudan and southern Somalia; no area is classified as Famine as of 13 Nov
state: FEWS NET's Sudan update for September 2026 to January 2027 says the risk of Famine has spread to Sharg Aj-Jabal in South Darfur and persists in parts of North Darfur and around Kadugli and Dilling, but no area is classified as Famine. FEWS NET also assesses a credible risk of Famine in southern Somalia from October 2026 to January 2027 (Dawan). WFP said on 12 Nov that about 900,000 people in Sudan have lost food aid since August because of funding cuts (UN News). Risk-of-Famine alerts set Watch.
for_you: People in Darfur, Kordofan and southern Somalia face severe hunger and malnutrition. Outside these areas, the main effects are more displacement and higher aid needs.
rubric_hit: Watch: FEWS NET 'risk of Famine' in Sudan and southern Somalia; no IPC Phase 5 Famine classification

sources.title: FEWS NET — Sudan: As drought compounds conflict, the risk of Famine expands to parts of South Darfur

why: Famine is the most extreme humanitarian failure, almost always man-made by conflict.
drivers: War, sieges, aid access, harvest failure, funding cuts.

rubric.alert: Famine (IPC Phase 5) confirmed in at least one area.
rubric.watch: IPC Phase 5 projected or 'risk of famine' alerts.
rubric.normal: No IPC Phase 5 (Famine) classifications or projections.
